title: Grateful Dead Live at Frost Amphitheatre on 1982-10-10

ai_review.summary: Crisp matrix recording captures a high‑energy 1982 California show with smoking China Cat, explosive Loser and Looks Like Rain, plus unforgettable crowd‑singing moments.
ai_review.review: The upgraded Seamons matrix version is exceptionally clear, delivering the band’s tight yet loose vibe with Jerry’s “machine‑gun” guitar tone and Phil’s booming bass on China/Rider. Highlights include an outrageous Cassidy jam, a killer Sugar Magnolia break, and Bobby rallying the audience to sing both “I Can't Get No” and “Satisfaction,” making this one of the most memorable early‑80s shows.

ai_rating.rationale: All reviews are overwhelmingly positive, praising both performance (high energy, standout songs) and recording quality (crisp matrix with recent upgrades). The combined weight yields a near‑exceptional rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Very crisp, well‑balanced sound; recent Seamons 16/24‑bit upgrades removed sync issues and provide clean separation of instruments with minimal crowd bleed.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong, continuous flow with high energy throughout; seamless transitions and engaging crowd interaction.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Machine‑gun quality solos on Loser and Sugar Magnolia break; overall tone praised as full and edgy.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bombs away on China/Rider, providing a powerful bass foundation.
band_member_comments.Bob: Leads the crowd in sing‑along sections of “I Can't Get No” and “Satisfaction”; vocal presence highlighted during China Cat.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent’s creative keyboard work shines, especially in the Cassidy jam.
